catalogue.name: ES - League of Cogs
catalogue.readme:
The League of Cogs stands as an unyielding alliance of multiple city-ports of Sonnstahl driven by a common goal to defend their interests both politically, fighting the machination of Aschau politicians, and physically against raids and other cowardly attacks.

Though small in size and far from the political centers of the Empire, the armies of the League are known to sport the finest and most reliable weaponry, supplemented by exotic beasts accessible thanks to their privileged position as maritime trading hubs, and bolstered by the Engineering guilds rooted in these industrious cities. Well trained, their units function seemlessly with each other like as many parts of a biggest machine, giving the League the exceptional capacity for force projection needed to fulfill their duties.

sharedRules.name: Arbalest
sharedRules.description: Shots 1, Range 30″, Str 4, AP 1. First 3 ranks shoot if the unit is within 8” of a friendly Swordsmen unit.

sharedRules.name: Tracer Rifle
sharedRules.description: Shots 1, Range 48“, Str 5, AP 3. Combined Units of Artificers with Arbalesters ignore the aim modifier for Long Range with their Shooting Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Engineer
sharedRules.description: Once per Shooting Phase, select a friendly Ordnance within 6”: it gains Aim (3+).

sharedRules.name: Rocketeer
sharedRules.description: Shots 3, Range 48”, Str 5, AP 3, Multiple Wounds (D3).

sharedRules.name: Young Griffon
sharedRules.description: The model is mounted, see (Special Mount).

sharedRules.name: First Knight
sharedRules.description: The model is mounted on Horse, loses Devastating Charge and gains +2 AP. When joined to a unit of League Lancers, the unit gains Fearless.
